listing.name: Rocket: Robot on Wheels (Rocket-R)
listing.summary: Explore Rocket: Robot on Wheels (Rocket-R) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish the game’s setup
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose your own supported Rocket: Robot on Wheels US ROM in the upstream launcher. It verifies the game and remembers the chosen path. Use the upstream menus for controls and compatible mods; no game compilation or separate installer is needed for the published player.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose your own supported Rocket: Robot on Wheels US ROM in the upstream launcher. It verifies the game and remembers the chosen path. Use the upstream menus for controls and compatible mods; no game compilation or separate installer is needed for the published player. Default settings, saves, mod profiles, mod-specific saves, logs and crash reports live in AppData/Rocket-R, outside Portcove backups. The reviewed rocket-r-data current-folder fallback is declared if present. Bundled engine/mod resources remain version-owned. Use an external registration for a custom --config directory or developer runtime overrides. Existing external copies keep their files and runtime owner. Gameplay, platform minimums and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations.
